text: Enrique Monteverde, an elderly former Guatemalan dictator convicted of [genocide against the Mayan people|wrong|war and atrocity], goes free when the verdict is overturned, and protesters trap his family inside their house. At night he hears [a woman weeping|images|sounds, smells and silence], and most of his Kaqchikel staff quit. The new maid Alma, once seen wading through the pool into the house, teaches his granddaughter to hold her breath under water, while his wife dreams of [soldiers drowning two children|wrong|harm done to children] and [the disappeared gather in the garden|threat|the restless dead].
